conditions.transport: LAN direct to isolated local KonomiTV
conditions.playback: recorded MPEG-2 TS Original, YADIF double-rate, true fullscreen
conditions.tabRule: one page per run; playback stopped, fullscreen exited, page closed, Chrome stopped after every run

seek90.method: 90 alternating seeks to 540 and 900 seconds; observe each for 1800 ms

capacityPressure.method: After explicitly starting YADIF double-rate, suppress only every other presentation for 2 seconds inside an 8-second sample. Retain rVFC input. Run three fresh pages per build.

instrumentation.productionControlLogic: Exact 52a3db5 and 26484fd logic respectively. No one-field presentation policy or queue-control change.
instrumentation.testOnly: Both builds add the same every-other-presentation hook and passive counters for FIFO retirement, presentation retirement, full reset, and pre-retirement oldest-field lateness.

capacityPressure.latenessDefinition: Maximum max(0, requestAnimationFrame timestamp - oldest queued field scheduled time), sampled before any retirement in #present().

conclusion: The formal candidate reduced direct 90-seek stalls from 35 to 1. Under the two-second synthetic presentation shortage, both formal builds had zero full resets; the candidate bounded pre-retirement presentation lateness to 6.52 ms and retired the required fields through a phase-dependent mix of capacity FIFO and existing presentation retirement. The earlier 14-15 reset and 83.3 ms comparison came from a predecessor/full-reset diagnostic build and is not evidence for this submitted build.

excludedRuns.reason: A first attempt had YADIF presentation stopped (draws=0 and outputFps=0). It was rejected before an output file was accepted. The rerun explicitly required Deinterlacer.running=true, doubleRate=true, and at least one canvas draw.

Preliminary A/B runs measured lateness only after retirement, which necessarily reported the displayed field as 0 ms late under the existing multi-field presentation policy. They were superseded by the documented pre-retirement oldest-field definition and are not included.
